title: Dental PPO Plans Primary Carrier Payment on Reprocessed Grace-Period Lines
content:
**Rule.** The other-carrier adjustment of a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after a not-eligible denial made during a premium grace period (a reprocessed grace-period line) follows the primary payment recorded on the decision it replaces, and so decides the patient share:
- when that payment is above 0.00 and the plan coordinates by non-duplication, the normal benefit is reduced by it, never below zero;
- when it is above 0.00 and the plan coordinates by standard coordination of benefits, the payment is limited to the allowed amount less it;
- when none is recorded, no adjustment is made.

The reduction acts on the normal benefit; the limit then applies to the payment ahead of the annual-maximum ceiling.

**Secondary payment method by plan.** Non-duplication: Preventive 750, Value 1000, Classic 1250. Standard coordination of benefits: Plus 1500, Premier 2000, Elite 2500.

### Input, judgement, output (hypothetical)
| Plan | Normal benefit | Allowed amount | Primary payment | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value 1000 | 63.10 | 121.80 | 70.00 | 63.10 less 70.00 is below zero, so 0.00 |
| Premier 2000 | 63.10 | 121.80 | 70.00 | Limited to 121.80 less 70.00, which is 51.80, so 51.80 |
| Premier 2000 | 63.10 | 121.80 | none | 63.10, no adjustment |
